items.title: Locally Gorenstein algebras, a generalization of Gorenstein algebras
items.abstract: For an Artin algebra $Λ$, we define the class of locally Gorenstein modules, which is a generalization of semi-Gorenstein projective modules and, therefore, a generalization of projective Gorenstein modules. For a locally Gorenstein module $X\in{\rm mod}\ Λ$ we construct $\underline{χ}_X$ a subcategory of $\underline{\rm mod}$ $Λ$ and we prove that the syzygy functor is faithful and full on $\underline{χ}_X$. Using that, we prove that the Igusa-Todorov functions $φ$ and $ψ$ vanish on the family of locally Gorenstein modules. Finally, using locally Gorenstein modules, we define the locally Gorenstein algebras, a generalization of Gorenstein algebras, and we prove that their finitistic, and the $φ$ and $ψ$ dimensions are finite.

items.llm_tldr_en: Defines locally Gorenstein modules over Artin algebras, proves the syzygy functor is full and faithful on a subcategory and that Igusa-Todorov functions vanish, yielding finiteness of dimensions for locally Gorenstein algebras.
items.llm_tldr_cn: 论文针对Gorenstein代数理论，对Artin代数Λ引入局部Gorenstein模这一比半Gorenstein投射模更广的概念。作者构造稳定模范畴的子范畴并证明syzygy函子在其上满忠实，进而证明Igusa-Todorov函数φ和ψ在局部Gorenstein模上为零。据此定义局部Gorenstein代数并证明其finitistic维数与φ、ψ维数有限，推广了Gorenstein代数理论。
